candidates.claim: The first entry of CORP_IN (fw-01:60, permit tcp 192.168.30.45/32 to 10.10.10.40/32 dst port 3389) is effective and lets a corporate host open an RDP connection into the OT engineering workstation 10.10.10.40, which the intents forbid.
candidates.remediation: Remove the CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60, or limit CORP access to the approved jump host 10.10.20.30 on tcp/3389 only.

candidates.claim: The effective CORP_IN permit at fw-01:60 (tcp/3389 from 192.168.30.45 to the OT engineering workstation 10.10.10.40) is not an approved cross-zone service, since the only approved path to 10.10.10.40 on tcp/3389 is from the DMZ jump host 10.10.20.30 (A4), not directly from CORP.
candidates.remediation: Remove the direct CORP-to-EWS permit at fw-01:60 so that all OT access is mediated by the jump host in the DMZ.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison reports one deviation: the access-list CORP_IN line at fw-01:60 (permit tcp 192.168.30.45 to 10.10.10.40 port 3389) is present in the current fw-01 configuration but absent from the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile fw-01:60 with the change record and either approve it into the baseline or remove it from the configuration.
